blocks.text: A Tampa CPA Explains the ‘Bottom Line’ in Accounting

Most people in business are all-too-familiar with the term “bottom line.” It is often used to describe a company’s profit, although it may also be used in general conversation to describe the ultimate result or outcome of an event, or as the deciding or critical factor in an argument. In accounting, the term came into common usage because the final, or bottom, line of a financial statement usually is reserved to display net income or net loss.

A [Tampa CPA](http://reliancecpa.com) at Reliance Consulting, LLC, is always here to help you do everything possible to ensure that the bottom line for your company or in your personal life best illustrates the profitability of your financial enterprises.
